metadata.rq: What mechanisms drive acquired resistance to KRAS G12C inhibitors and what combinations overcome them?

sub_questions.objective: Catalog on-target secondary KRAS/RAS mutations driving resistance.
sub_questions.output_format: Annotated sources + 2-3 sentence finding per paper; T1-T4 labels.
sub_questions.source_guidance: PubMed + PubTator3 (KRAS entity); Paperclip full text.
sub_questions.boundary: On-target mutations only; excludes bypass-pathway mechanisms (SQ2).

sub_questions.objective: Map bypass / parallel pathway reactivation (RTK-SHP2, MET, EGFR).
sub_questions.output_format: Annotated sources + 2-3 sentence finding per paper; T1-T4 labels.
sub_questions.boundary: Bypass signaling only; excludes histologic transformation (SQ3).

sub_questions.objective: Characterize histologic / EMT transformation as a resistance route.
sub_questions.output_format: Annotated sources + 2-3 sentence finding per paper; T1-T4 labels.
sub_questions.boundary: Phenotypic transformation only; excludes combination trials (SQ4).

sub_questions.objective: Enumerate combination regimens in clinical investigation with trial identifiers.
sub_questions.output_format: Table of regimens + trial IDs + status; T1-T4 labels.
sub_questions.boundary: Clinical combinations only; excludes preclinical mechanism (SQ1-SQ3).
